text:
olga.r: Heads-up: planning a short pricing experiment next week to test a capacity-discount (bulk-embed) vs baseline for high-throughput customers. Primary asks: invoice tagging, grandfather rules, and a fast rollback plan.

mike.h: What's the exact discount rule? sliding scale at 1M+ tokens/day gets 12% off? We need to avoid negative unit prices with credits.

olga.r: Rule = customers with avg_daily_tokens > 1,000,000 over last 30d get tier "bulk" with -12% to embed unit. Cohort selected via analytics tag 'bulk_test_v1'. Grandfathering=true blocks.

devin.a: Ops: add invoice.metadata.experiment="bulk_capacity_test" and invoice.metadata.variant (baseline|bulk). Also set invoice.metadata.rollout_id for traceability. Rollback = clear flags and re-export previous price map for affected invoice window.

tammy.l: Sales wants a prejudice-free exemptions flow. Proposal: SFDC case tag "bulk-exempt"; auto-approve if ARR < 15k; finance review if >=15k. Legal review if ARR > 75k.

mike.h: We must account for customers with committed credits. If discount applies on top of credits we can end up with negative net_due; auto-issue credit memo for negative nets < $500, manual review for >= $500.

billing-bot: [automated] New experiment created: bulk_capacity_test | cohort=bulk_test_v1 | start=2026-08-03 | id=exp_20260803_bulk

devin.a: Monitoring: add dashboard widget 'experiment_net_delta', 'credit_memo_count', and 'exported_invoices_with_experiment'. Alert if more than 4 customers have >10k delta or median percent change >5%.

olga.r: Safety: canary export for 5 customers first window (Friday 09:00 PT). If any customer delta > 8% we halt. Also schedule a rollback window at 2hrs post-launch if threshold breached.

tammy.l: Communication: pre-notice email template ready. Sales will include proration example and link to dispute form.

mike.h: One more: vendor settlements. Do not change vendor settlement amounts; account for discount as internal absorb GL entries.

devin.a: I'll add GL codes mapping and a quick migration script to add invoice metadata fields. Keeping schema minimal to avoid long migrations.

olga.r: Thanks. If everyone is good we proceed with schema change Thursday night and canary Friday. I'll update the exemptions sheet and post the rollback checklist. :white_check_mark:
